arStrings.szText:
Each attack damages Close enemies for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns and also deals {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2*100|%|"]{/c} of this damage as Poisoning over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.

Each time you've retaliated with Thorns, for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds the Poisoning damage is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4*100|%|"]{/c}, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3*100|%|"]{/c}.
